rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_odd_e.classification_evidence: A within-season half-season split of a rate this noisy is the weaker instrument of the two and its interval spans zero on both sides; it neither confirms nor refutes the season-to-season persistence, and a single near-zero reliability estimate whose interval contains zero is not the zero-reliability closing ground.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_odd_e.description: Companion within-season split-half of the same crew trait: a head referee's underdog-cover rate on odd weeks against even weeks of the same season (290 referee-seasons, minimum 3 games per half, Spearman-Brown corrected value -0.0377, season-blocked bootstrap, seed 20260821). Reported alongside the season-to-season pairing, which is the predeclared primary.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_odd_e.notes: Second look at a window already read on 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-08; descriptive, not independent confirmation. Correlated with the officials_archive_battery family, which measures the same rule against a different baseline.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_odd_e.plain_summary: Splitting each referee's season in half by odd and even weeks finds no signal either way -- half a season is too few games to see a tendency this faint.

rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_seaso.classification_evidence: Reliability is small but POSITIVE and the interval only just includes zero (probability_positive 0.9505), so the trait is not shown to be noise and no_split_half_reliability is NOT available as a closing ground for this family.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_seaso.description: Split-half reliability of the crew trait the rookie-crew rule depends on: a head referee's underdog-cover rate in a season, paired with the same referee's rate in the following season (255 referee-season pairs, 16 seasons, season-blocked bootstrap, seed 20260821, label-shuffle null mean 0.0144 sd 0.0584). This is the year-to-year persistence question; tenure itself is not measured because it increments by construction.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_seaso.notes: Second look at a window already read on 2026-09-05 and 2026-09-08; descriptive, not independent confirmation. Correlated with the officials_archive_battery family, which measures the same rule against a different baseline.
rookie_crew_reconciled_reliability_seaso.plain_summary: Referees carry a faint tendency from one season to the next in how often the underdog covers their games -- faint, but pointing the same way year after year rather than washing out.

rookie_crew_served_step_flagged_games_ca.classification_evidence: Not terminal on any admissible ground. The interval crosses zero, which is never grounds to close anything; probability_positive 0.7077 week-blocked and 0.7180 season-blocked both favour the candidate, so wrong_sign_resolved is unavailable in any case. The trait's split-half reliability is +0.0756, 95% [-0.0201, +0.1453], probability_positive 0.951 season-to-season over 255 referee pairs, so no_split_half_reliability is unavailable. No positive control was run at this effect size, so positive_control_bound is unavailable.
rookie_crew_served_step_flagged_games_ca.description: The reconciled rookie-crew rule AS WIRED into nfl_ats.pick_refresh: a refresh-time refit on feature profile weak_stack_rookie_crew_underdog (production weak_stack plus one signed rookie_crew_underdog_flag column, archive-extended referee tenure with season floor 2010, signed by the underdog side of the frozen Tuesday line, close-proxy line before 2020), whose opener side replaces the model-only side ONLY on games whose own crew is flagged. Marginal on the served nine-member card overlay_union_coach_division_arrests_bye_coldvisitor_protection_interim_tank_precip_v3 at the OPENER grade, 1,537-game archive (1,503 non-push).
rookie_crew_served_step_flagged_games_ca.notes: Measured 2026-09-09. Paired week- and season-blocked bootstrap, 20,000 samples, seed 20260821, within-week correlation zero, pushes excluded. Served card baseline 56.8862 percent on 487 union flips (reproduces docs/served_card_harness.md exactly); with the step 56.9528 percent, 3 changed picks. This is the SUBSET arm actually served: the predeclared arm in docs/rookie_crew_reconciliation.md also lets the refit move UNFLAGGED games (coefficient drift), and re-measured this session that reads +0.133067, week 95% [-0.197109, +0.465735], probability_positive 0.790450 on 6 changed picks, reproducing the harness lane's +0.133 / 0.7904 to the digit. The served step is narrowed to flagged games because AGENTS.md requires a pick flip to name a mechanism and a drift-only change on an unflagged game names none. Per-era, as wired: 2020-2021 +0.2193 [0.0000, +0.6667] probability_positive 0.8197 on 1 changed pick; 2022-2023 0.0000 [-0.5792, +0.5769] probability_positive 0.4971 on 2; 2024-2025 0.0000 on 0 changed picks -- magnitude statements per era, never absence. Reused 1,537-game opener archive: descriptive reused-window measurement with a stated discount, not independent confirmation. Correlated with rookie_crew_reconciled_card_2020_2025, of which it is a subset; never pool the two as independent inputs.
rookie_crew_served_step_flagged_games_ca.plain_summary: When the referee working a game is in his first or second season, back the side the model likes once it knows that. Over 2020-25 this changed 3 of our picks and moved us from 56.9 percent to 57.0 percent right against the opening line -- about 71 percent likely to be an improvement, which is small and not settled, but better than a coin flip. This week it applies to exactly one game.
